limits: 626 is sum of actual passing libtest execution rows (default260/allfeatures346/vendor20), not626 unique functions or USB/hardware cases. Five TLS scenarios/two backpressure/four signal cases are separate lifecycle reporting.

New secure5cases are memory-DER cfg(test) actual-adapter tests; safe CI summary prints precondition counts/cleanup-observed flags, not their full before/stopped snapshots. Successful exact source assertions and unit test link them; no absent runner/tmp snapshots are invented. No per-child test-ELF digest is printed for these five cases; actual executable inode/digest proof is available only in the separate four-signal summary.

Three raw safe PID/TID/comm/wchan observations are actually printed in each new CI log. They now prove current Ubuntu24 anon_pipe_write and Ubuntu22 pipe_write. Earlier39997678019 failures lacked these observations and are not retroactively filled.

Legacy4signals prints actual before/after facts, child PID/starttime/UID and executedELF guard plus a dynamically counted before/after source inventory; all logged source bytes metadata match immutableGit. Its indexed runner artifacts are not uploaded/downloaded, so their contents cannot be independently rehashed here beyond data printed in full summary.

Legacy2backpressure prints result/status/capacity/no-drain/socketEOF only; no per-child ELF guard. It is linked by fixed preceding workflow build/source/target path with no rebuild, never upgraded to stronger source/ELF proof.

Four-signal build says external prebuilt; not inferred. Allfeatures attribution is from successful fixed scripts/check.sh execution and two recorded release completions, not invented from --skip-build.

The successful immutable check.sh has ten sequential set-e commands, but CI does not use bash-x tracing: fmt/Clippy command arguments are linked to that script and successful named step, not claimed as separately printed expanded commands. Release/doc completions and each actual unit result row are printed.

No trusted-root loader, helper/realUSB, QEMU/hardware, fullG3 or universal leakage claim from these loopback tests. Current QEMU matrix and source/ELF proofs are separate evidence, not supplied by CI logs; CI does not validate website edits pending publication.
